manuscript.Introduction: Stroke prevention is a public-health priority. This study aims to test whether coffee intake reduces stroke risk in adults.
manuscript.Methods: A cross-sectional survey of 400 adults recorded coffee intake and self-reported stroke history in one hospital.
manuscript.Results: Coffee intake was associated with lower stroke risk (OR 0.8, 95% CI 0.6-0.9).
manuscript.Discussion: Coffee therefore causes a reduction in stroke risk in all adults.
